title: I Played a lot of Demos and got into Cracking
desc: My Journey began with PC Magazines like: ComputerBild, Chip, other and a lot of Demo Games. Until i discovered that full games can be cracked and played. I invested a lot of time into it.

title: Call of Duty 1.1 got Released
desc: This release changed a lot for me. My first Nickname "mufelz". I learned a lot about a Multiplayer, GameServers (also later with Hamachi), Clans, People. Later i opened my own Clan and changed a lot of times the names. My first Website was made with homepage-baukasten.de

title: I Started to Learn PHP
desc: In This time i started to Learn PHP and used CMS's like ilch.de and Webspell. I made Designs (using HTML and CSS), Plugins and got in Touch with my first RootServer. First i started with and Simple TextEditor but i got my hands on Macromedia Dreamweaver (now Adobe Dreamweaver) and used it.

title: My First Website
desc: Around 2005 got my first Website released for my Call of Duty 1.1 Clan. This was a full Custom CMS with User and Admin Panel i made it with PHP. Since then i made a lot of Designs and Content Management Systems for me and other people.

title: The C and C++ Journey started
desc: In This time i was thinking about to make my own Game. I made my own 2D Platformer but i never released it to the public. A few people played it... Clan Members and People from my TeamSpeak Server.

title: I joined a new Clan XoF (Xtreme online Fighters)
desc: This same Year was my new Gaming Home Xtreme online Fighters (XoF) and my Gaming Name was first "taplix" then "fensziii". We played CounterStrike Source, Call of Duty 4 aktive and more Games. We started to play CoD4 in the ESL. It was a great time and they made me the Co-Leader of XoF and Later on of the Leaders. I Managed the Website, RootServer and our GameServer's.

title: Adobe After Effects
desc: I started to Learn After Effects and made my own Frag Movies with CounterStrike and Call of Duty Gameplay and released it on a Site Called Wipido.com (now a honey)

title: Something new and got Published
desc: In this time i heard of a new project called "Bitcoin" and i invested a lot of time into it and lost a lot nervs later on.

title: My First Business Idea
desc: In this time i got an awesome idea. Why not making a small Business with my Skills. My first Idea was born shine-host.de Sponsoring and an ShopCMS (Free and OpenSource with an Premium Option) with Features like: Sell Front-End, Client Panel, Admin Panel, Ticket System and a lot more. But i was Young and had No Expirience in Businesses and Law (Someone wanted to sue me because he changed ~10 Lines in my Codebase and was thinking about to grab the project for his self).

title: We Closed XoF and i joined FsK
desc: Around 2010 got XoF closed by us. I and an other Member joined FsK (FreundesKreis). At that time they had a Website with ilch.de and i made a new Design. Again i managed the RootServer's and everything running on it.

title: Blender, Unreal Engine was an new Journey
desc: 3D Videos and 3D Game Developent was my new Journey and a good one i learnd a lot about 3D, Animations and more

title: A NEW Journey Began
desc: New Programming Languages called Rust and Go got released, a GameEngine called Godot and my interest was big.

title: Crypto
desc: Around 2015 i started investing more time into Crypto

title: Zig got released
desc: Since then i had an eye on Zig.

title: Projects, Skills and more
desc: This time i used a lot of my Time to make Projects, Plans and Improve my Skills in Programming, Marketing, Law and other things. I Started to teach kids to make 2D Games with Godot and GDScript.

title: OpenSource
desc: Investing more time into OpenSource Projects and my own Projects.

title: Started work on my own Business
desc: I made a plan and since then i'm working on my own Business.
